_about: Everything Little Red Riding Hood (stories/little_red_riding_hood.json) needs. Open-air scenes keep the plain cream page; the sun, clouds and gull come from 精卫 and the dusk sky from 夸父. The girl is painted first with the 精卫 bird as the paper-texture reference; every other image references her.
style: Style: children's picture-book art made entirely of cut pieces of hand-painted tissue paper, matching the paints and paper textures of the attached reference. Inside each piece: bold acrylic brush streaks, sponge mottling and comb-scraped texture in a few rich colours. Crisp scissor-cut edges. Flat, layered collage with no 3D shading and no outlines. Everything sits on a plain, flat, evenly lit cream paper board that fills the whole image. No cast shadows, no frame, no text, no letters, no numbers.

assets.prompt: A single little girl from a European fairy tale, about seven years old: Little Red Riding Hood. A bright red hooded cape with the hood up around her face, short brown bob hair, a round friendly face with rosy cheeks, a blue dress with a white apron, dark shoes. Standing, front view, arms relaxed at the sides, a small wicker basket covered with a checked cloth hanging from the hand on the right of the picture, the whole figure visible from the top of the head to the shoes. The figure is isolated in the middle of the board with a wide empty margin of board on every side.

The attached image is a cut-paper girl. Make the puppet parts sheet: the same girl taken apart into separate flat cut-paper pieces, laid out on the board like parts before assembly. Pieces: the head with hair and neck and the hood; the body (clothes, without arms and without legs) with the cape; the arm on the left of the picture with its hand; the arm on the right of the picture with its hand; the leg on the left of the picture with its shoe; the leg on the right of the picture with its shoe; the basket on its own. The joint end of every limb (shoulder, hip, neck) is cut straight. Keep every colour, paint and texture exactly as in the attached girl. Every piece is complete and whole, nothing overlaps, and plain board shows between all pieces with clear gaps. Leave a wide empty margin of board around the edges.
